Mum when I was 14: How do you ever expect to get a husband with scars like that?! Me at 14: I'm so stupid and worthless, no one is ever going to love me, I've ruined myself, I should die. Me, now happily married to a man who loves my scars: Hah! Suck on that, Mum!

Right, from now on my sexual orientation is ambisextrous 😂
I just had such a heartbreaking text conversation with my ex and I'm really upset... is there someone who would be willing to talk to me?

My uni courses are opening up and I'm currently reading the text book for my course Developmental Psychology (the course I'm most excited for this semester). Uni starts next week and I'm excited, not only for the learning but also to hopefully make some friends 😊

Dogs are honestly the sweetest animals. I'm watching online lectures for my first week of uni and I'm tired, so I made a tired/exasperated sigh and rested my head on my arms, so my sister's dog came to me and is currently licking my leg. My heart has melted ❤️

I start uni tomorrow, and I know that I will be fine, but my anxiety is skyrocketing.

So I didn't end up making it to my first day of uni, because I got some bad news this morning. The tumour that got cut out of my neck? Papillary Thyroid Cancer. I'm okayish, and I will be okay. The treatment is easy, more surgery and injections, but I won't even need chemo.
